projects.title: Upskilling & Building in AI
projects.description: Currently brainstorming and developing new ideas focused on deep learning, generative AI, and advanced techniques like RAG. Stay tuned!

projects.title: Celeste Clone
stats: No game engine — fully custom renderer
projects.description: A 2D platformer prototype inspired by Celeste, built from the ground up in C++ with a custom OpenGL renderer — no game engine involved. Features hot-reloadable gameplay code, an in-house level editor, keyframe-based moving platforms, and full localization into English, German, Hindi, and Marathi. Every system, including font rendering (FreeType) and audio, was written by hand.

projects.title: 2D Game Engine
projects.description: A custom 2D game engine in modern C++ built as a deep-dive into engine architecture. Implements an ECS (Entity-Component-System) framework from scratch, SDL2 rendering, Lua scripting via Sol2, asset & memory management, input handling, and a simple collision system.

projects.title: DrEngine
projects.description: A fully custom 2D game engine following ECS architecture. Features automatic Python-based dependency setup, SDL rendering, dynamic DLL linking, batch rendering, and font rendering. Includes a Pong demo built with the engine. Actively maintained for cross-platform compatibility.

projects.title: ImGui Borderless Window
projects.description: A ready-to-use cross-platform template for borderless windowed applications based on Dear ImGui. Ships with multiple themes, font choices, and easy asset loading — ideal for mod menus, helper tools, and utility apps. Works on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Occasionally maintained to stay functional on all supported platforms.

projects.title: Snake Game (BGI)
stats: No external libraries — pure bare-metal C
projects.description: Classic Snake game built with the Borland Graphics Interface in C. The entire game — rendering, logic, input — lives in a single source file. A study in bare-metal C graphics programming.

projects.title: ScummVM — Open Source Contribution
projects.description: Contributed to the large-scale open-source project ScummVM. Navigated a substantial existing C++ codebase, extended existing systems, and implemented a new Cast Details window for the Director engine. Also handled bug tracking and fixes.

projects.title: Recipto
projects.description: An AI-powered receipt scanner and expense manager. Captures or shares receipt images (including from UPI apps), extracts transaction details via AI, categorizes expenses, tracks financial goals, and generates monthly PDF reports delivered by email. Visualizes spend with pie charts.

projects.title: Mood Chat
projects.description: A real-time chat app with a twist: the UI theme morphs dynamically based on the emotional sentiment of the conversation, powered by Generative AI. Includes live video calling via WebRTC and Firebase authentication.

projects.title: TV Companion
projects.description: A two-app Android system for rich remote control of Android TV devices over LAN — beyond what the stock Google TV app offers. Supports URL launching, volume control, and live screen streaming from TV to phone.

projects.title: Android Projects (MAD Internship)
projects.description: A learning sprint: 41 Android applications developed in Java and XML as part of a Mobile Application Development internship during the Diploma in Computer Engineering. A broad survey of Android APIs, UI patterns, and device integrations in a single repository.
